papers.title: Do Patients Value the Service Provided by Physicians Who Overbill? A Willingness-to-Pay Study Using French Survey Data.
papers.abstract: Outpatient specialist physicians in France can work either in the regulated sector, where they charge the regulated fee, or in the unregulated sector, where they set their own fees above the regulated fee. This context provides a unique opportunity to estimate the extent to which patients value services provided under balance billing. In January 2021, we carried out a contingent valuation method (CVM) survey on a sample of 1051 individuals who were representative of France's adult population. Results highlighted that willingness-to-pay (WTP) for a specialist consultation in the unregulated sector was higher than for a consultation in the regulated sector, with a significant WTP difference of €4.30 (almost 15% of the regulated fee). This difference was significant across all respondent subgroups (i.e., gender, age, education level, marital status, income, health status, insurance coverage, and area of residence) and was not fully driven by differences in income. Moreover, this preference for the unregulated sector was associated with the perception that specialists in this sector provide better quality medical care, better quality non-medical services, and that making an appointment with them is easier. Finally, we estimated the patient net welfare gain generated by specialist consultations in the unregulated sector in France at approximately €165 million per year. This is the first study to provide an estimation of patients' benefits associated with balance billing.
papers.summary: 針對法國門診專科醫師在管制與非管制部門（允許超額收費）的服務價值，本研究透過條件評估法（CVM）對1051名成年人進行調查。結果顯示，患者對非管制部門的支付意願（WTP）比管制部門高出顯著的4.30歐元（約為規定費用的15%），且此現象遍及所有受訪者子群體，並非僅由收入差異驅動。這種偏好主要來自於患者認為非管制部門的醫師能提供更好的醫療與非醫療服務品質，且預約更為便捷。
papers.significance: 本研究是首個量化患者從醫師超額收費中獲得效益的文獻，打破了過去僅將超額收費視為患者福利損失的傳統觀點。研究估算法國非管制部門專科診療每年能為患者創造約1.65億歐元的淨福利收益，這對於評估雙軌醫療定價制度、醫療保險政策以及醫療服務市場的福利分配具有極重要的政策參考價值。

papers.title: Stigmatism among physicians and nurses towards patients with alcohol use disorder: a systematic review.
papers.abstract: Alcohol use disorder (AUD) is a common and debilitating condition in Western countries. AUD is often stigmatized, which can worsen the condition and be a barrier for treatment seeking. This is a systematic review that aimed to identify and analyze stigmatizing attitudes and behaviors of physicians and nurses towards patients with AUD in Western hospital and primary care settings, 2014-2024. The study also examines potential differences between physicians and nurses, settings, and changes over time. A systematic review was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA reporting guideline. Pubmed, PsycINFO and Embase were searched using MeSH terms and free-text keywords covering alcohol use disorders, healthcare professionals and stigma-related concepts (e.g. "Stereotyping," "Attitude," "Prejudice"). Two reviewers independently completed the full screening of articles, data extraction, and quality assessment. The included studies were assessed for quality using the Critical Appraisal Skills Programme (CASP). Of the 2835 articles screened, 11 studies were included. Stigmatizing behaviors and attitudes towards patients with AUD were common and often characterized by stereotyping, prejudice, and negative feelings. Recurring themes and patterns included avoidance of patients, moral judgment, and perceptions of patients as resistant to treatment, all contributing to the perception that treatment is futile. No differences were observed between physicians and nurses, across healthcare settings, or over time. The qualitative studies were generally of higher quality, while the quantitative studies showed methodological weaknesses. Stigmatizing attitudes and behaviors towards patients with AUD persist among physicians and nurses, hindering effective care. Further research, including patient perspectives and ethnographic approaches, is needed to understand these behaviors and their impact on patient care and treatment-seeking. Addressing stigma is crucial for improving care outcomes.
papers.summary: 本系統性文獻回顧探討了2014至2024年間，西方國家醫院與基層醫療中，醫護人員對酒精使用障礙（AUD）患者的污名化態度與行為。研究篩選了2835篇文獻並納入11篇進行分析。結果顯示，醫護人員對AUD患者的污名化現象普遍存在，具體表現為刻板印象、偏見、負面情緒、迴避患者及道德評判，並常將患者視為抗拒治療，導致認為治療徒勞無功。研究未發現醫生與護士、不同醫療環境或不同時間點之間存在顯著差異。
papers.significance: 此研究揭示了醫護人員對AUD患者的污名化問題依然根深蒂固且未隨時間改善，這成為患者尋求治療的重大障礙並削弱了醫療照護的有效性。該結果強調了醫療體系迫切需要介入以消除相關污名，並呼籲未來研究應納入患者視角與民族誌方法，以全面評估污名化對醫療行為的影響，從而改善AUD患者的照護品質與治療成果。

papers.title: Issues navigating the healthcare delivery system among caregivers of children and youth with special healthcare needs: a qualitative study.
papers.abstract: Caregivers of children and youth with special health care needs (CYSHCN), including those with disabilities, have numerous roles managing care for their children. While caregiver burden is well documented, less is known about how barriers within the healthcare delivery system contribute to this burden and how systems can be redesigned to better support families. This study explored Illinois caregivers' experiences navigating the healthcare delivery system for CYSHCN and sought their perspectives on resources needed to reduce caregiver burden. We conducted a qualitative study as part of a statewide needs assessment in Illinois. Three focus group discussions were conducted with caregivers of CYSHCN recruited through partner organizations. Discussions included participatory activities to elicit priority health needs and concerns for families of CYSHCN in Illinois. Audio recordings were transcribed verbatim, coded, and analyzed by the research team using content analysis to identify themes related to systems-level drivers of caregiver burden and potential solutions. Caregivers (n = 22) described substantial emotional, logistical, and financial burden arising from fragmented healthcare delivery and insurance systems. Key challenges included poor communication and coordination across providers and health systems, inconsistent electronic health record integration, limited access to pediatric specialists, and inadequate availability and reliability of in-home nursing care. Insurance-related barriers, including instability in coverage, prior authorization requirements, and gaps in coverage for needed supplies, further exacerbated caregivers' strain. Despite these challenges, participants also identified approaches, resources, and supports they have utilized that mitigate caregiver burden, such as multidisciplinary care models, family-centered providers, and support networks. Caregivers emphasized the need for expanded care coordination and navigation, increased mental health supports for families, more flexible insurance and reimbursement policies, and greater investments in home-based care. The findings from this study underscore the need for improvements to the healthcare delivery system through coordinated efforts. Health systems and payers should prioritize the expansion of family-centered care coordination, strengthen communication across providers, and invest in a more stable home healthcare workforce. Advancing disability-inclusive, family centered systems through these strategies is essential to fostering better outcomes for both caregivers and CYSHCN.
papers.summary: 本研究透過質性研究探討伊利諾伊州特殊醫療需求兒童及青少年（CYSHCN）的照顧者在醫療體系中面臨的挑戰。研究發現，碎片化的醫療與保險系統給照顧者帶來了龐大的情緒、後勤與財務負擔。主要障礙包含跨醫療機構溝通與協調不良、電子病歷整合不一致、兒科專科資源短缺、居家護理不可靠，以及保險覆蓋不穩定與預先授權繁瑣等。雖然多學科照護模式與支持網絡能減輕部分負擔，但照顧者仍強烈呼籲擴大照護協調服務、提供更多家庭心理支持，並制定更具彈性的保險與居家醫療投資政策。
papers.significance: 此研究凸顯了現行醫療給付體系對特殊需求家庭造成的系統性壓力，為醫療機構與保險支付方提供了明確的改革方向。透過推動以家庭為中心的照護協調、強化跨機構資訊整合，以及穩定居家醫療人力，不僅能有效減輕照顧者負擔，更是建立包容殘障、以家庭為導向的醫療體系、提升整體醫療照護結果的關鍵策略。

papers.title: Social determinants of health and epigenetic clocks: a systematic review and meta-analysis of 140 studies.
papers.abstract: Social determinants of health-such as socioeconomic status (SES) and race and ethnicity-strongly shape health. Individuals with lower SES or marginalized identities experience earlier onset of disease and shorter lifespans. 'Epigenetic clocks' measure biological ageing and are increasingly used to study healthy ageing, yet it remains unclear which clocks are most sensitive to social inequality. Here we conducted an Open Science Framework-pre-registered systematic review and meta-analysis of 140 studies (N = 65,919; 1,065 effect sizes) testing associations of SES and race and ethnicity with three generations of clocks. PubMed, PsycINFO, Web of Science, medRxiv and bioRxiv were searched from February 2024 to September 2025. Eligible studies included empirical articles in English published since 2013 on non-clinical populations reporting at least one relevant association. Associations between SES and biological ageing varied across different generations of epigenetic clocks (F(2) = 178,10, P < 0.001), with the weakest effects for first-generation clocks (r = -0.03, 95% confidence intervaI (CI) [-0.04, -0.01], P < 0.001) and stronger effects for second- (r = -0.11, 95% CI [-0.12, -0.09], P < 0.001) and third-generation clocks (r = -0.13, 95% CI [-0.15, -0.11], P < 0.001]). Sex, tissue and array minimally modified results, and publication bias was negligible. Limitations include inconsistent reporting of technicalities and overrepresentation of data from high-income countries. The findings indicate that newer clocks are more responsive to social inequality.
papers.summary: 本系統性回顧與統合分析涵蓋140項研究（共65,919名受試者），探討社經地位與種族等社會決定因素與三代「表觀遺傳時鐘」測得之生物學衰老的關聯。結果顯示，社經地位較低與生物學衰老加速的關聯強度隨時鐘世代遞增，第一代時鐘效應最弱，第二代與第三代時鐘效應顯著較強，且此趨勢不受性別或檢體組織類型影響，發表偏誤極低，顯示新世代時鐘對社會不平等更具敏感度。
papers.significance: 此研究為公共衛生與老化科學領域樹立了方法學標準，證實新一代表觀遺傳時鐘能更有效地捕捉社會不平等對健康造成的生理影響。這項發現不僅有助未來研究在探討健康不平等時選擇更精準的生物標記物，更強化了將社會經濟因素納入精準醫學與健康老化評估模型的科學依據，對制定促進健康公平的政策具有重要意義。
